loading.subtitle: Escape Game: The City Sends an SOS

infoModal.title: INSTRUCTIONS
infoModal.instructions: Once you press the signal for the incident you selected, you can move using the WASD keys. The keyboard must be set to English to move.

controls.joystick: Use the joystick (bottom left) to move

messages.welcome:
CP TEAM, 112 is overwhelmed with calls: minor accidents, injuries, children needing help!
Only you can locate the incidents, arrive at the spots on time, and provide first aid.
Your mission is to:
• Solve the riddles to find where in the city each incident occurred.
• Select the correct spot on the map before time runs out.
• Answer the first aid questions correctly to save the person in need.

Remember:
• Don't rush – read every clue carefully.
• Work with speed and safety!
• Every correct answer brings you closer to success!

Are you ready to start your mission?
You don't have much time... the city needs you now!
messages.falseAlarmMessage: False alarm! No incident here! Try again!
messages.quizFailMessage: That wasn't the right choice. Think carefully again and give it another try!

quest1.title: Park
quest1.riddle: Someone slipped and hurt their knee! They are where people enjoy the sun lying under thick leafy shade while chatting, where children play after school.
quest1.successMessage: You arrived quickly! Little Nick has an abrasion on his knee. That's part of the game!

quiz.question: 🤕 What do you do?
options: Clean with clean water and cover with sterile gauze.
Pour rubbing alcohol or hydrogen peroxide on the wound to disinfect.
quiz.feedback: ✅ Well done! You cleaned the wound with clean water, applied sterile gauze, and told Nick to keep the area clean.

quest2.title: Stadium
quest2.riddle:
Alarm! The temperature in the city has risen dangerously. You hear anxious voices on the radio.

Grass without trees,
a crowd shouting loudly.
A ball rolls and the sun burns.
What place is this where everyone runs but no one leaves?

Where will you head now, CP TEAM?

quiz.question: Luckily you arrived on time. A child collapsed during practice! He is flushed and looks very tired! Heatstroke! What do you do?
options: Give ice to cool him down.
Suggest not moving him and notify his family.
Move the child to a cool place and give him water.
quiz.feedback: ✅ Congratulations, you prevented a serious episode of heatstroke. The child wasn't wearing a hat and wasn't drinking enough water during exercise. Did you see what happens if one doesn't take proper protection measures?

quest3.title: Pool
quest3.riddle:
You are drinking water to stay hydrated when suddenly a kid on a scooter gives you a message:

Water without waves,
dives without fish,
run to where they guard lives with a whistle!

CP TEAM run!
quest3.successMessage: Yes, you arrived correctly. Although it's hot, the child has hypothermia!

quiz.question: 🥶 What is the correct first step for hypothermia?
options: Warm the person slowly and cover them.
Put them in front of a heater.
quiz.feedback: ✅ Correct action! Hypothermia doesn't only appear in the snow or when swimming in freezing water in winter. It can happen after a long swim or exposure to wind, even in summer. So be careful!

quest4.title: School Yard
quest4.riddle:
You receive a message on your mobile:

It has no desks or blackboard,
but every recess a lesson in friendship happens there.
In this space, your composure will be tested!
quest4.successMessage:
You arrived in time, CP TEAM!
Yes, a child is lying in the yard. No one knows what to do!

quiz.question: 😵 What do you NOT do?
options: Raise his legs a little higher.
Open up space for air and call for help.
Pour water on him and give him something to eat to perk him up.
quiz.feedback: ✅ You guessed right! The child fainted from the heat and the exhaustion of playing. Maybe also because he didn't eat a good breakfast!

quest5.title: Town Hall
quest5.riddle: Run to where the celebration starts, when the clock shows 7.
quest5.successMessage: You arrived on time! At the Town Hall, at an event for students, a child ate chocolate with peanuts. Suddenly he started turning red, coughing, and struggling to breathe. Yes! You thought correctly! Allergic reaction!

quiz.question: 🥜 What do you do?
options: Nothing. Wait for it to pass.
Ask the child if he has an allergy and if he has adrenaline (EpiPen) with him, and call 112 (or 166).
Give water or food to the child to "calm down".
Lay the child on his back without checking if he is struggling to breathe.
quiz.feedback: ✅ Well done! You reacted correctly and saved precious time — in an allergic crisis, immediate action makes the difference!
